description: KCoder native overlay: GitHub-style summary card (header icon/title/total +N/−N/actions, mono file rows with right-aligned deltas, show-more footer, hover highlight; review mode expands per-file red/green hunks) and pure-audit conclusion card on the upstream ProducedFiles turn-tail entry. Applied in place onto the running dsh installation tree by desktop/main/native-overlay.ts; regenerated against .patches/dsh-client-ui-deliverables-original when the pinned upstream version moves. Mark bumped from kcoderc:deliverables-review so trees carrying the previous overlay re-apply.
